awesome-ai-companion（Background Heartbea.desc: Chinese field guide for moving a long-term companion into your own Telegram bot on MochiBot + OpenRouter + a VPS: compile a long Skill into a persistent Core, verify it via request dumps, migrate old chats into memory, systemd uptime, backups, and a troubleshooting list. ElevenLabs voice is marked experimental. CC BY 4.0 text, MIT code. `Guide` · `MochiBot` · `adapt`.
